title: What If Money Grew On Trees?

publish.title: What If Money Grew On TREES? #shorts
publish.description: What if every tree in town started growing dollars and everybody got rich at the same time? What would you buy first?
publish.caption: What if money grew on trees? 🌳💸

scenes.line: What if money grew on *trees*?
scenes.title: WHAT IF...

scenes.line: One morning, Grandpa's apple tree started growing *dollars*.
By lunch, every tree in town was *loaded*.
I picked a thousand bucks before *breakfast*.
Zoe bought a pony. Jay bought a second *pony*.
Max bought nine hundred *cakes*. He is seven.
Nobody went to school. Nobody went to *work*.
Best week of my *life*.
Then I got hungry. I went to buy a *pizza*.
The pizza guy was not *there*. He was rich now.
Nobody was baking. Nobody was *driving*. Nobody was fixing.
Jay found one pizza left. It cost a million *dollars*.
We had a million dollars. *Everyone* did.
Money was everywhere. So money meant *nothing*.
People used it as *napkins*. Then as pillows.
The only person not worried was *Grandpa*.
He never picked the money. He kept growing *tomatoes*.
Suddenly, his tomatoes were worth more than *gold*.
The whole town lined up at his *farm*.
Jay offered him ten million. Grandpa said *no*.
He wanted something *else*. He wanted help.
One hour of digging for one *tomato*.
So for the first time in a week, I *worked*.
My arms hurt. My back hurt. The tomato tasted *amazing*.
Soon everybody was trading. Bread for haircuts. Pizza for *songs*.
The town came back to *life*.
And the money trees? In autumn, the leaves just fell *off*.
We raked it up and made a huge *pile*.
Max *jumped* in it. That is what money is for now.
I still have one dollar from that week. On my *wall*.
It reminds me: the tree was never the *treasure*.
Grandpa was. Also, his tomatoes. Seriously, *try* one.
